body:
**Blocked by #167.**

### The duplication is two backends, not one component rendered twice

- `/settings/notification-queue` is a bespoke UI on `src/actions/notifications/queue-management.ts` (153 lines: get / stats / delete / clearQueue).
- The Queue tab inside `/settings/notifications/history` renders `QueueViewer`, which goes through `src/hooks/use-notifications.ts` to `src/actions/notifications/queue.ts` (395 lines — the module the rest of the notification system, including sending, is built on) offering cancel and retry.

### Decision

**`queue.ts` + `QueueViewer` survive; `queue-management.ts` is retired.** It is the integrated path, wired to react-query cache invalidation.

**Accepted loss:** hard-delete and "Clear Queue" go away; cancel and retry replace them. This was chosen deliberately — do not port them back without raising it.

### Change

- `/system/notification-queue` renders `QueueViewer` standalone.
- `/system/notification-history` renders `NotificationHistory` standalone.
- Redirect the old tabbed `/settings/notifications/history`.
- Update the "View History" link at `src/app/(dashboard)/settings/notifications/page.tsx:264`.
- ROUTE_PERMISSIONS: add both new paths with `NOTIFICATIONS_MANAGE`; keep the old entries.

### Docs

`website/docs/settings/billing-and-notifications.md` sources `settings/notifications/**`.

### Verify

`npm test`; cancel and retry still work from the new location.
